facts.statement: The fuzz entry invokes md_html on the bytes remaining after two unsigned flag words; the build recipe links that entry with the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles and links the fuzz entry's md_html call.

facts.statement: After the change, MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is 0x10000 and enables ||hidden text|| spans; the span contract says they are recognized only with that flag.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the flag value and its spoiler syntax.

facts.statement: A finite input can put MD_FLAG_SPOILERS in the first unsigned word and ||text|| in the remaining bytes. The entry passes both to md_html, which puts parser_flags into MD_PARSER before calling md_parse.

evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the bit to encode in the first flag word.
md_html copies the supplied parser flags into the parser configuration.
md_html invokes md_parse with that configuration and input.

facts.statement: The recipe configures CMake with BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF and links the two static libraries; it supplies no parser flag setting to the entry.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry obtains parser flags from fuzz input.

facts.statement: The complete before span enum does not declare a spoiler span. Its pipe collector creates single-pipe marks for table or wiki-link handling.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the before collector's pipe handling.

facts.statement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, the after parser includes '|' in its mark-character map and collects adjacent pipes as one potential opener-and-closer mark.

evidence.dependency_reason: The flag makes pipes eligible for mark collection.
The double-pipe handler precedes the single-pipe handler and records a two-character mark.

facts.statement: Ordinary text has a route from md_parse through document and block processing to inline analysis and processing. Inline analysis calls the spoiler delimiter analyzer outside table mode.

evidence.dependency_reason: md_parse starts document processing.
Document processing reaches all blocks.
The ordinary leaf-block route calls normal block contents.
Normal block contents analyzes and then processes inline marks.
Inline analysis collects marks and calls md_analyze_link_contents outside table mode.
Flagged, unresolved two-character pipe marks are sent to md_analyze_pipe.

facts.statement: The after pipe analyzer resolves a paired opener and closer. Inline processing dispatches resolved double-pipe marks as spoiler span callbacks, whose HTML handlers emit opening and closing x-spoiler tags.

evidence.dependency_reason: Pairs and resolves the double-pipe marks.
Turns the resolved pair into spoiler span callbacks.
The opening callback renders <x-spoiler>.
The closing callback renders </x-spoiler>.

facts.statement: The old entry already supplies the flag and Markdown needed for this spoiler behavior through its md_html call, so its input format does not block the frozen route. Its output callback discards rendered output, and the complete entry contains no assertion about that output.

evidence.dependency_reason: The spoiler flag can be represented by the fuzz-derived parser flag word.
md_html forwards those flags and input bytes to the parser.
